'''Corellian Intelligence''' was the primary military intelligence agency for the worlds in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and was vital to the [[Confederation]].

==History==
The agency dated as far back as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] where [[Erris Wyum]] served as an agent that liased with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. His report from Corellian Intelligence revealed that the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] was overloading the reactors of the Imperial battle cruiser [[Eclipse (Harrower-class)|''Eclipse'']] in order to bring widespread devastation on the surface of Corellian which would have killed millions.

During the early stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], this organization became a rival to [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service]] as both factions attempted to outmaneuver one another in an effort to gain an advantage for their respective governments.
